kernel_invariants: source evidence cannot directly create entitlement
policy must be explicit and versioned before entitlement
authority must be explicit before effect
settlement eligibility is distinct from authorization
settlement requires current evidence and preserved claim ceiling
profile adapters cannot widen source claims
foreign recognition does not imply local issuance
correction appends lineage rather than mutating history
profile_rule: profile-specific policy may restrict kernel transitions but may not weaken kernel invariants
